retirement_audit.scope: Supplemental disposition of pinned inputs; comparator sections above are unchanged. Dispositions count category occurrences, not distinct data losses.

after_audit_date.evidence: Dated Nov 30–Dec 3; absent from the pin, not excused by timing. Recompare against a refreshed CT pin.

before_audit_date.evidence: Dated Sep 23, Sep 30 and Nov 9. Reconcile with Congress.gov/CT capture lineage; not just upcoming-meeting lag.

changed_title.evidence: 338792 upstream adds S.5289 and judicial nominations; archive title is generic calendar business.

whitespace_or_case.evidence: Collapse Unicode whitespace and compare case-insensitively. Includes NBSP at 118654 and 119507.

changed_sitting.evidence: 119601 upstream Dec 1 vs archive Nov 19, also the status residual.

local_date_same_start.evidence: Same sitting start, same America/New_York calendar day; date comparison used UTC.

archive_only_building.evidence: Same-update, same-start sitting with archive building and no stated upstream building.

archive_only_room.evidence: Same-update, same-start sitting with archive room and no stated upstream room.

changed_room.evidence: 119453 upstream room 2220 vs archive 2128 with same sitting start.

changed_sitting.evidence: 119601 and 338794: exact upstream start missing in archive sittings.

newer_update_archive_adds_building.evidence: 119575 gains a building from archive, but upstream update timestamp is newer.

newer_update_same_start_and_location.evidence: Same start and normalized location, but newer upstream publisher update; do not infer whole detail parity.

missing_package_candidate.evidence: At least one extra jacket on the event has no archived CHRG package with matching Congress and trailing digits.

package_candidate_without_event_link.evidence: Congress/jacket package candidates exist but at least one excess jacket has no same-event meeting or witness edition link. A global package is not association parity.

same_event_package.evidence: 119212 jacket 64287 is retained as CHRG-119hhrg64287 on an edition linked to this event; absent specifically from meetings.transcripts. Consumers must use the edition link.

recording_present_meeting_urls_absent.evidence: YouTube recording key on the same event; exact Congress.gov landing link absent from archive meeting videos. Validate surface/canonical landing link before retiring.

canonical_split_form.evidence: Each missing name on this event is an exact normalized form of the canonical appearance name, with one or both split rank/credential fields omitted. Name parity only.

name_not_verified.evidence: At least one name has no verified same-event exact normalized appearance form or linked canonical person variant. No fuzzy identity matches accepted.

other_appearance_or_person_name_variant.evidence: All names have same-event evidence in a noncanonical appearance or a linked canonical person name/variant. Verify replacement consumers follow those links; not position, organization or identity parity.

no_appearances.evidence: 119575 is in meetings but has no archive appearances; 4 upstream.

no_meeting.evidence: 119615 and 119616 missing from archive with 4 and 5 upstream entries, respectively.

no_url_offered_and_no_linked_edition.evidence: Senate 338792: 2 upstream metadata entries without URL and no archive linked edition.

url_offered_but_no_linked_edition.evidence: 12 House events; separately checked for document links via witnesses, none. Example 118252: 13 offered URLs, no linked edition.

no_exact_meeting_reference.evidence: No lookup or same-event metadata reference, and no same-event equal-basename edition.

reference_without_matched_edition.evidence: Exact URL retained in document_references, but no lookup and no alternative linked edition on that event with the same basename.

same_event_basename_candidate.evidence: Exact meeting reference and linked edition with identical basename, often docs.house.gov. Neither original lookup alias nor byte equivalence is proved.

meeting_documents_link_metadata.destination: meetings.document_references (listed meetingDocuments); description, name and role map directly, unlike list.title/document_kind. Archive document views do not project these three link fields.
meeting_documents_link_metadata.reference_match_method: Same event and exact URL, description/name/role with Unicode whitespace collapsed and blank mapped to null, case-insensitive format; compare tuple multiplicity by occurrence number. URL-less rows require an otherwise identical tuple with null URL. Exact match does not imply same source order, body coverage or proof of download.
